steps.instruction:
【Agent】global://design-ux-architect（~/.claude/agents/design-ux-architect.md）
【输入】`docs/prd.md`
【上下文】以当前工作区与用户本次对话中的需求为准；若工作区已有相关文档，优先阅读后再执行。

【任务】用户流程、信息架构、页面清单、可落地的 HTML/CSS 骨架说明

【禁止】不写后端/API

【READ】Read upstream artifacts first (pre-injected if exist): `docs/prd.md`.
【WARN】If a file path doesn't exist, do NOT read/fake it. Work with what's available or ask.

【PATH】`docs/ux-architecture.md`
【WRITE】Use `workspace-write` fences or code blocks with file paths to write. System auto-saves your reply.

【1】Base on pre-injected state. No fake docs. Never read/fake non-existent files.
【2】Your reply IS the artifact. Produce structured Chinese markdown.
